category_title: Difficult students who alternate between ostentatious task engagement and masked transgressive play
minimal_context: The student is practicing somersaults in a small group tumbling workshop along the gym wall.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please start the tumbling workshop and practice your somersaults.

STUDENT: (Performs the required somersault, then stays lying down on his back for 10 seconds) I did the somersault.

TUTOR: Get up and keep practicing.

STUDENT: (Trips up Maureen and laughs) I'm practicing.

TUTOR: Pay attention to the exercise.

STUDENT: (Quickly shoves Ines just when she does the exercise so she falls, then pushes Alice who was about to do a roll) Me and my friends have a good laugh. I do it quickly and discreetly so I don't get caught by the teacher.

options.A: Explicitly incorporate elements into the tumbling workshop that promote self-compassion during the somersault exercises and throughout the remaining sessions.
options.B: Understand the relationship between the student's 'Fight' responses and anxiety, and frame them into positive coping strategies during the tumbling workshop and future sessions.
options.C: Opt for a consistent workshop organization plan that reduces the workspace along the gym wall and allows the teacher good visual control of the whole class.
options.D: Implement a specific 'Termination' stage counting down the final 3-5 sessions of the tumbling workshop, maintaining this structure for the remainder of the class.
